hooks.name: Non-diagnostic guardrail reminder
hooks.description: Injects the core scientific and privacy guardrails on every prompt so they hold even when guardrails.md drifts out of active context.

action.prompt: Reminder: this is a non-diagnostic research prototype. Follow .kiro/steering/guardrails.md — never fabricate ancestry calls, clinical classifications, allele frequencies, or risk values to fill a UI gap; use explicit unavailable/not-assayed/unscorable states. Use "consider"/"confirm", never diagnostic or treatment language. A no-call or missing variant is never a reassuring negative. Never let raw genotypes/alleles reach logs, analytics, URLs, or transmitted payloads.
